correctness.rationale: Exact graph distance equals ceil(cyclic distance/2). The parity decomposition, Fourier transforms of the cyclic second difference and Dirichlet sign sequence, and sign inequalities for all even and odd n reconstruct the complete claim; the n=9 zero-frequency case is exact. Gaussian universal positivity is equivalent to nonpositive nonconstant distance Fourier eigenvalues. A separate BFS and DFT checker was executed successfully for n=3..128 (CHECK_OK 732270); finite checks do not replace proof.

value.rationale: This supplies a natural infinite-family classification of squared-Euclidean/negative-type graph metrics and universal Gaussian positivity, where parity and the exact isolated n=9 case are not obvious from the graph definition. The odd Fourier formula, rank of the centered embedding and explicit obstruction modes connect finite harmonic analysis to kernel stability; not a reparameterization of the known even spectrum.
